items.title: Stryker (SYK) Launches Mako RPS To Bring Robotic Knee Surgery To More Surgeons
items.summary: Stryker has introduced Mako RPS, a robotic handheld system for total knee replacement, expanding its Mako robotics portfolio. The launch extends robotic assistance to a wider range of orthopaedic procedures and care settings. The development highlights Stryker's focus on robotic-assisted surgery and surgeon flexibility in knee replacement. Stryker, traded as NYSE:SYK, is drawing attention with the launch of Mako RPS alongside a share price of $336.74. The stock is up 5.5% over the past week...

items.title: Intuitive Surgical Fell 37% to $355 With This Wall Street Pro Is Calling for $685
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical just posted its fifth consecutive earnings beat and management started buying back shares above current prices, yet the stock sits at a level that implies something far worse than a slowdown.
